SampReadAdminSecurityDescriptor()
Source: secadmin.c
Retrieve security descriptor of AdminSDHolder object as ProtectedSecurityDescriptor & ProtectedSecurityDescriptorLength

div.div:
Walk through the rpMembers list and update the security descriptor to ProtectedSecurityDescriptor.
After rpMembers list, repeat for BuiltinLocalGroups, DomainUsers, and ExclusiveGroups.
Only write to the object if the member is in the same domain as the DC is authoritative for & skip anything that is not a security principal by measuring SID length.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 378px; height: 1px; padding-top: 267px; margin-left: 442px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
SampUpdateSecurityDescriptor()
Source: secadmin.c
This is the function responsible for comparing the security descriptor of the object against the AdminSDHolder security descriptor and then stamping the AdminSDHolder SD on the object if it's not a match.
